skills.name: Let's go, Sadaharu! (行くネ、定春！)
skills.description: Kagura & Sadaharu attack a single target dealing damage equal to 25% and 70% of their ATK in that order. Then inflict the target with Straight Man and Sadaharu's Heavy Attack respectively, both effects last for 2 turn. ;Straight Man (ツッコミ) : :'''Debuff, Status''': Decreases DEF and RES by 50%, lasts for 2 turns. ;Sadaharu's Heavy Attack (定春重撃) : :'''Debuff, Status''': Max of 3 stacks. At the start of turn, dealt indirect damage equal to 33% of their ATK, lasts for 2 turns.

skills.name: Gotta Protect (守護必達)
skills.description:
Exclusive effect. When an ally with Umbrella Shield attacks a single enemy, Kagura & Sadaharu will Assist with a normal attack.
When an ally with Umbrella Shield is inflicted with a debuff or control effect, they will launch up to 4 counter-attacks per turn on the source. Their move is increased by 5% when an enemy with Sadaharu's Heavy Attack receives damage from a single target attack (can trigger once per attack).
;Sadaharu's Heavy Attack (定春重撃)
:
:'''Debuff, Status''': Max of 3 stacks. At the start of turn, dealt indirect damage equal to 33% of their ATK, lasts for 2 turns.
;Umbrella Shield (傘の盾)
:
:An undispellable shield that can absorb damage equal to 180% of ATK (cannot exceed 200% of the target's max HP). Reduces non-indirect damage received by 60%.

skills.name: Go All Out (全力以赴)
skills.description: Kagura grants Umbrella Shield to an ally, lasts for 3 turns. Also increases the move bar for herself and the ally by 30%. ;Umbrella Shield (傘の盾) : :An undispellable shield that can absorb damage equal to 180% of ATK (cannot exceed 200% of the target's max HP). Reduces non-indirect damage received by 60%. :''(An orb with a small circling umbrella around it will appear around protected allies to indicate that the shield is active.)''

upgrades.text: Absorption for Umbrella Shield increases to 200%.
Absorption for Umbrella Shield increases to 220%.

When Kagura & Sadaharu deal damage, the HP for allies' Umbrella Shield is restored by 80% of the damage dealt until the shield HP is restored back to the initial 220% ATK and refreshes the duration for the turn.
When Kagura & Sadaharu are not Immobile, they gain Umbrella Shield at the end of turn.
